Temperance sits in the present position. An angel stands with one foot in the water and the other on the shore, pouring water between two cups in a steady stream. That steady pour is the pace you have been looking for at work. Keeping one foot in the water is how you stay connected to feeling while the other foot keeps you grounded.

### The Tower

The Tower follows. Lightning strikes the top of the tower and the crown is knocked loose, while two figures fall. The falling crown is the old title you were holding onto.","cards":["Temperance","The Tower"],"sourceComplete":true}'
